title: Manufacturing and Trade: Inventories and Sales (September 2026 data) — the first combined business-inventories print on the restated wholesale basis, 10:00 a.m. ET
source: CENSUS: two census.gov primaries re-fetched direct 2026-10-18 by this event's own pulse check (HTTP 200 each, desktop user-agent). (1) economic-indicators/calendar-listview-2026.html (89,130 bytes), row "Manufacturing and Trade: Inventories and Sales | November 17, 2026 | 10:00 AM | September 2026", release code A202611171000, reference A202609. (2) census.gov/mtis/index.html Notice of Revision, verbatim: "Revisions to the Wholesale estimates will be released October 26, 2026, and will be reflected in the September 2026 MTIS release scheduled for November 17, 2026." Both the 09-06 initial research's grounds for holding this at estimate are gone: Census's verb moved from "anticipated" to "will be reflected ... scheduled for", and the retail leg of the same notice was delivered exactly as announced (09-28 revision, reflected in the 2026-10-15 edition). Promoted estimate -> confirmed 2026-10-18 by the owning lane on two direct primary reads, the same closing path advance-services-q3-2026-11-19 took. Originally filed EST: 2026-09-06 from calendar-listview.html + the Atlanta Fed PostedUpdates row. Checked 2026-10-18
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN 2026-09-06 by this event's own initial research, after reading the single proposal that existed for this id (proposals/mtis-2026-11-17.from-mwts-benchmark-revision-2026-10-26.json, now shadowed and inert). Every claim in that proposal was re-derived this session rather than carried, and all of them survive. The identity, in one line: this is the edition Census itself names as the one where the 2023/2024 AIES wholesale restatement reaches the combined business-inventories series — so from 2026-11-17 both trade legs (64.9% of inventories, 69.1% of sales at June-2026 weights) stand on the new basis while manufacturers, 35.1%, is frozen by the M3 special notice for the remainder of 2026. The trap the proposal named reproduces exactly: a tracked entry already occupies 2026-11-17 and it is a different release — retail-sales-2026-11-17 is the 08:30 Advance Monthly Retail Trade report for OCTOBER data (A202611170830, reference A202610), while this is the 10:00 MTIS for SEPTEMBER data (A202611171000, reference A202609). Different hour, different reference month, different report; MTIS has never once printed without that 08:30 companion (84 of 84). Impact LOW and symbols empty on the same measured grounds as the sibling Census entries: no house playbook is macro-keyed (grep of trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md re-run 2026-09-06, 0 hits) and no instrument attaches. Date stays estimate; nothing here licenses an entry. PULSE 2026-10-18 (D-30): promoted estimate -> confirmed on two Census primaries (see source); wholesale revision still scheduled 2026-10-26 and still named as reflected in this release. Impact stays low and symbols stay empty; confirmation licenses nothing.
